                     walk_notes=[(8, "F#1", 48, True), (10, "F#2", 62, False), (11, "E-2", 56, False),
                                 (12, "A#1", 52, True), (14, "A#2", 62, False), (15, "C#2", 58, False)])

    # Pat 5: Bm7 | E7 | Amaj7 -> Dmaj7 | G#m7b5 -> C#7 (Circle of Fifths!)
    p5 = patterns[5]
    _driving_beat_bar(p5, 0,  variant=0, clap_layer=True)
    _driving_beat_bar(p5, 16, variant=3, clap_layer=True)
    _driving_beat_bar(p5, 32, variant=1, clap_layer=True)
    _fill_bar(p5, 48, "chorus_lift")
    _bass_octave_bar(p5, 0,  "B-1", "B-2", sub_note="B-1")
    _bass_octave_bar(p5, 16, "E-2", "E-3", sub_note="E-2",
                     walk_notes=[(12, "E-2", 48, True), (14, "F#2", 58, False), (15, "G#2", 60, False)])
    _bass_octave_bar(p5, 32, "A-1", "A-2", sub_note="A-1",
                     walk_notes=[(8, "D-2", 48, True), (10, "D-3", 62, False), (11, "A-2", 54, False),
                                 (12, "D-2", 48, True), (14, "B-1", 58, False), (15, "A-1", 58, False)])
    p5.off(48, 4)
    _bass_octave_bar(p5, 48, "G#1", "G#2",
                     walk_notes=[(8, "C#2", 56, True), (10, "C#3", 62, False), (12, "C#2", 58, False),
                                 (13, "B-1", 58, False), (14, "C#2", 60, False), (15, "E#2", 64, False)])

    # =========================================================================
    # SECTION III: ANTHEMIC CHORUS ("KEYGEN OVERDRIVE") (Patterns 6..9, Bars 25..40)
    # =========================================================================
    # Pat 6: Dmaj7 | E | C#m7 | F#m -> E
    p6 = patterns[6]
    _driving_beat_bar(p6, 0,  variant=3, clap_layer=True, crash=True)
    _driving_beat_bar(p6, 16, variant=1, clap_layer=True)
    _driving_beat_bar(p6, 32, variant=3, clap_layer=True)
    _driving_beat_bar(p6, 48, variant=2, clap_layer=True)
    _bass_octave_bar(p6, 0,  "D-2", "D-3", sub_note="D-2")
    _bass_octave_bar(p6, 16, "E-2", "E-3", sub_note="E-2")
    _bass_octave_bar(p6, 32, "C#2", "C#3", sub_note="C#2")
    _bass_octave_bar(p6, 48, "F#1", "F#2", sub_note="F#1",
                     walk_notes=[(12, "E-2", 50, True), (14, "E-3", 62, False), (15, "D#2", 58, False)])

    # Pat 7: Dmaj7 | E/G# | A -> E/G# | F#m -> C#/E#
    p7 = patterns[7]
    _driving_beat_bar(p7, 0,  variant=3, clap_layer=True)
    _driving_beat_bar(p7, 16, variant=1, clap_layer=True)
    _driving_beat_bar(p7, 32, variant=2, clap_layer=True)
    _fill_bar(p7, 48, "mid_tom")
    _bass_octave_bar(p7, 0,  "D-2", "D-3", sub_note="D-2")
    _bass_octave_bar(p7, 16, "G#1", "G#2", sub_note="G#1")
    _bass_octave_bar(p7, 32, "A-1", "A-2", sub_note="A-1",
                     walk_notes=[(8, "G#1", 48, True), (10, "G#2", 62, False), (11, "E-2", 56, False),
                                 (12, "G#1", 48, True), (14, "G#2", 62, False), (15, "G-2", 58, False)])
    _bass_octave_bar(p7, 48, "F#1", "F#2", sub_note="F#1",
                     walk_notes=[(8, "E#2", 54, True), (10, "C#3", 62, False), (12, "C#2", 58, False),
                                 (14, "D-2", 60, False), (15, "D#2", 60, False)])

    # Pat 8: Dmaj7 | C#7/E# | F#m -> F#m/E | B7/D# (Dorian spotlight!)
    p8 = patterns[8]
    _driving_beat_bar(p8, 0,  variant=3, clap_layer=True, crash=True)
    _driving_beat_bar(p8, 16, variant=1, clap_layer=True)
    _driving_beat_bar(p8, 32, variant=3, clap_layer=True)
    _driving_beat_bar(p8, 48, variant=2, clap_layer=True)
    _bass_octave_bar(p8, 0,  "D-2", "D-3", sub_note="D-2")
    _bass_octave_bar(p8, 16, "E#2", "C#3", sub_note="C#2")
    _bass_octave_bar(p8, 32, "F#1", "F#2", sub_note="F#1",
                     walk_notes=[(8, "E-2", 48, True), (10, "E-3", 62, False), (12, "E-2", 48, True), (14, "E-3", 62, False), (15, "E-2", 56, False)])
    _bass_octave_bar(p8, 48, "D#2", "B-2", sub_note="B-1",
                     walk_notes=[(12, "D#2", 50, True), (14, "B-2", 62, False), (15, "C#2", 58, False)])

    # Pat 9: Bm7 | C#m7 -> Dmaj7 | E -> C#7/E# | F#m (Stop-Time Break!)
    p9 = patterns[9]
    _driving_beat_bar(p9, 0,  variant=0, clap_layer=True)
    _driving_beat_bar(p9, 16, variant=1, clap_layer=True)
    _driving_beat_bar(p9, 32, variant=3, clap_layer=True)
    _fill_bar(p9, 48, "break_stop")
    _bass_octave_bar(p9, 0,  "B-1", "B-2", sub_note="B-1")
    _bass_octave_bar(p9, 16, "C#2", "C#3", sub_note="C#2",
                     walk_notes=[(8, "D-2", 48, True), (10, "D-3", 62, False), (12, "D-2", 48, True), (14, "D-3", 62, False), (15, "D#2", 58, False)])
    _bass_octave_bar(p9, 32, "E-2", "E-3", sub_note="E-2",
                     walk_notes=[(8, "E#2", 50, True), (10, "C#3", 62, False), (12, "E#2", 52, True), (14, "C#3", 64, False), (15, "E#2", 60, False)])
    # Bar 40 stop-time bass hit on beat 3 (row 56) then clean silence!
    p9.set(48, 3, note="F#1", inst=I_BASS, vol=48, fx=0x9, param=0x10)
    p9.set(50, 3, note="F#2", inst=I_BASS, vol=60)
    p9.set(52, 3, note="F#1", inst=I_BASS, vol=50)
    p9.set(54, 3, note="C#2", inst=I_BASS, vol=56)
    p9.set(56, 3, note="F#2", inst=I_BASS, vol=64)
    p9.set(56, 4, note="F#1", inst=I_SUB,  vol=58)
    p9.off(58, 3)
    p9.off(58, 4)

    # =========================================================================
    # SECTION IV: CRYSTALLINE BREAKDOWN & BAROQUE SOLO BUILD (Pats 10..11, Bars 41..48)
    # =========================================================================
    # Pat 10: Atmospheric music-box & velvet sub-bass breathing space!
    p10 = patterns[10]
    p10.set(0, 2, note="C-4", inst=I_CRASH, vol=42)
    for r0 in [0, 16, 32, 48]:
        for pos in (4, 12):
            if r0 >= 16:
                p10.set(r0 + pos, 2, note="C-4", inst=I_HATC, vol=24)
        if r0 >= 32:
            p10.set(r0 + 12, 1, note="C-4", inst=I_CLAP, vol=30)
            p10.set(r0 + 8,  2, note="C-4", inst=I_HATC, vol=22)
    # Velvet sustained Sub-Bass only (Ch 3 rests for dramatic textural contrast!)
    for r0, sn in [(0, "F#1"), (16, "D-2"), (32, "B-1"), (48, "C#2")]:
        p10.set(r0, 4, note=sn, inst=I_SUB, vol=48)
        p10.set(r0 + 14, 4, fx=0xA, param=0x02)
    p10.set(56, 4, note="E#2", inst=I_SUB, vol=46)

    # Pat 11: Baroque Solo Acceleration Build (8th kicks -> 16th kicks -> massive 32nd roll!)
    p11 = patterns[11]
    _hat_16th_bar(p11, 0,  open_offbeats=False, crash_start=True,  intensity=0.78)
    _hat_16th_bar(p11, 16, open_offbeats=True,  crash_start=False, intensity=0.88)
    _hat_16th_bar(p11, 32, open_offbeats=True,  crash_start=False, intensity=0.96)
    # Bar 45: 4-on-floor kick; Bar 46: 8th kicks; Bar 47: 8th kicks + 8th snares; Bar 48: 16th/32nd eruption!
    for pos in (0, 4, 8, 12):
        p11.set(pos, 0, note="C-4", inst=I_KICK, vol=50)
    for pos in range(0, 16, 2):
        p11.set(16 + pos, 0, note="C-4", inst=I_KICK, vol=52 + pos // 2)
    p11.set(20, 1, note="C-4", inst=I_SNARE, vol=48)
    p11.set(28, 1, note="C-4", inst=I_SNARE, vol=54)
    for pos in range(0, 16, 2):
        p11.set(32 + pos, 0, note="C-4", inst=I_KICK, vol=56)
        p11.set(32 + pos, 1, note="C-4", inst=I_SNARE, vol=38 + pos)
    # Bar 48 (r0=48): Explosive 16th kick + 32nd snare + tom eruption!
    for pos in range(16):
        p11.set(48 + pos, 0, note="C-4", inst=I_KICK, vol=52 + pos // 2)
        sv = 36 + int(pos * 1.9)
        fx = 0xE if pos >= 12 else None
        prm = 0x92 if pos >= 14 else (0x93 if pos >= 12 else None)
        p11.set(48 + pos, 1, note="C-4", inst=I_SNARE, vol=min(64, sv), fx=fx, param=prm)

def _hat_16th_bar(pat, r0, open_offbeats=True, crash_start=False, intensity=1.0):
    """Sculpted 16th-note hi-hat groove over 1 bar (16 rows starting at r0)."""
    base_vels = [44, 24, 38, 26,  40, 22, 38, 28,  42, 24, 38, 26,  40, 24, 40, 30]
    for i in range(16):
        r = r0 + i
        vel = max(12, min(60, int(round(base_vels[i] * intensity))))
        if i == 0 and crash_start:
            pat.set(r, 2, note="C-4", inst=I_CRASH, vol=min(56, int(50 * intensity + 6)))
        elif open_offbeats and i in (2, 6, 10, 14):
            pat.set(r, 2, note="C-4", inst=I_HATO, vol=min(56, vel + 6))
        else:
            pat.set(r, 2, note="C-4", inst=I_HATC, vol=vel)

Think syncopation with a bit of a demoscene/breakbeat feel, but still driving 4-on-the-floor, punctuated by double-kick pickups on rows 14 or 30, and dramatic stop-time breaks to keep things interesting.  We'll work in half-time/accelerating build breakdowns. Let's make those melodic electronic tom fills (`F#4 -> D4 -> B3 -> G#3 -> F#3`) happen in bars 8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 56, and 64!

Channel 1 will handle the Snare and Clap – instruments 2 and 3. I'm envisioning snappy backbeats on beats 2 and 4 (rows 4 and 12 of each bar), with subtle ghost-note snares, between 18 and 24 volume, and that ED1 micro-groove, on 16th offbeats (rows 7, 9, and 15). Layered Clap accents are essential for the Chorus, and then, those thrilling E92 / E93 32nd-note crescendo snare rolls are going right in bars 8, 24, 48, and 64!

Shimmering Crash_Crystal will land on structural downbeats - including Pattern 0 Row 0 for our seamless loop impact, and at all the obvious structural points throughout the song!

Finally, Channels 3 and 4, the Bass. We're talking Kick-Bass Lock and ducking: Channel 3 (Bass_PluckSaw, inst 8) will be locked to the kick. Whenever the Kick hits on the downbeats (r % 4 == 0), the Bass_PluckSaw will play at volume 36, and the correct fx and param, cleanly jumping into the phase-locked loop so the transient never fights the kick's beater click. On the off-beat 8ths and syncopated 16ths (r % 4 in (1, 2, 3)), it'll jump an octave up (F#1 -> F#2 or D2 -> D3) at full volume (58..62), with the full resonant SVF pluck bite. That sidechain/transient separation will keep the low-end punch ultra-clean while giving the bassline unmistakable keygen bounce and propulsion! Channel 4 (Bass_SubWarm, inst 9) provides smooth sustained sub-fundamental weight in the Chorus and Breakdown, also gently ducked after kick beats, and clearly keyed off before chord changes!

"""Assemble tune.xm via FT2, render WAV + stem buses, and run full DSP/mix/loop verification."""

import base64, json, subprocess, sys, wave
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace/src")
from instruments import build_all_instruments
from theory import Pattern
from drums_bass import write_drums_and_bass
from melody_harmony import write_melody_and_harmony

SONG_NAME = "Razor Horizon"
BPM = 144
SPEED = 6
CHANNELS = 12
N_PATS = 16

def run_ft2_batch(ops, json_path="/workspace/scratch/build_ops.json"):
    with open(json_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(ops, f)
    res = subprocess.run(["ft2", "batch", json_path], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if res.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"ft2 batch failed ({res.returncode}): {res.stderr[:1000]} {res.stdout[:1000]}")
    # Check if any tool reported isError: true
    for line in res.stdout.splitlines():
        if '"isError": true' in line or '"isError":true' in line:
            raise RuntimeError(f"ft2 tool error: {line}")

def build_module_ops(insts, patterns, order_list, loop_start=0, active_channels=None):
    ops = [
        {"name": "module_new", "arguments": {"channels": CHANNELS, "name": SONG_NAME}},
        {"name": "song_set", "arguments": {
            "name": SONG_NAME, "bpm": BPM, "speed": SPEED,
            "length": len(order_list), "loop_start": loop_start, "channels": CHANNELS
        }},
    ]
    for ins in insts:
        pcm_b64 = base64.b64encode(ins["pcm"].tobytes()).decode("ascii")
        ops.append({"name": "instrument_set", "arguments": {"instrument": ins["id"], "name": ins["name"]}})
        ops.append({"name": "sample_create_from_pcm", "arguments": {
            "instrument": ins["id"], "sample": 0, "pcm": pcm_b64, "encoding": "int16", "name": ins["name"]
        }})
        ops.append({"name": "sample_set", "arguments": {
            "instrument": ins["id"], "sample": 0, "name": ins["name"],
            "volume": ins["volume"], "panning": ins["panning"],
            "finetune": ins["finetune"], "relative_note": ins["relative_note"],
            "loop_start": ins["loop_start"], "loop_length": ins["loop_length"],
            "flags": ins["flags"]
        }})

    for p in patterns:
        if active_channels is None:
            ops.extend(p.to_ft2_ops())
        else:
            p_sub = Pattern(p.pat_idx, p.rows, p.channels)
            for (r, ch), cell in p.cells.items():
                if ch in active_channels:
                    p_sub.cells[(r, ch)] = dict(cell)
            ops.extend(p_sub.to_ft2_ops())

    for pos, pat_idx in enumerate(order_list):
        ops.append({"name": "order_set", "arguments": {"position": pos, "pattern": pat_idx}})
    return ops

def load_wav(path):
    with wave.open(str(path), "rb") as w:
        sr = w.getframerate()
        nch = w.getnchannels()
        raw = np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()), dtype=np.int16).reshape(-1, nch)
    return sr, raw

def dbfs(val):
    return 20.0 * np.log10(max(val, 1e-9) / 32768.0)

def analyze_master(sr, audio):
    fl = audio.astype(np.float64)
    peak = np.max(np.abs(fl))
    clips = int(np.sum(np.abs(audio) >= 32767))
    rms_all = np.sqrt(np.mean(fl ** 2))
    rms_l = np.sqrt(np.mean(fl[:, 0] ** 2))
    rms_r = np.sqrt(np.mean(fl[:, 1] ** 2))
    dc_l, dc_r = np.mean(fl[:, 0]), np.mean(fl[:, 1])
    corr = float(np.corrcoef(fl[:, 0], fl[:, 1])[0, 1])

    print("=== MASTER AUDIO QA ===")
    print(f"Duration       : {len(fl)/sr:.3f} s ({len(fl)} stereo frames @ {sr} Hz)")
    print(f"True Sample Pk : {int(peak)} / 32768 ({dbfs(peak):.2f} dBFS), Clipped samples = {clips}")
    print(f"Integrated RMS : {dbfs(rms_all):.2f} dBFS (Crest factor = {dbfs(peak) - dbfs(rms_all):.2f} dB)")
    print(f"L / R Balance  : L={dbfs(rms_l):.2f} dBFS, R={dbfs(rms_r):.2f} dBFS (diff = {dbfs(rms_l)-dbfs(rms_r):+.2f} dB)")

    analyze_master(sr, master_wav)

    # 2. Build 2x-loop-unrolled module to inspect the EXACT loop wrap seam (Pat 15 -> Pat 0)!
    ops_loop = build_module_ops(insts, patterns, list(range(N_PATS)) + [0, 1], loop_start=0)

        ("Bass  (Ch 3-4)",     {3, 4}),

"""Assemble tune.xm via FT2, render WAV + stem buses, and run full DSP/mix/loop verification."""

import base64, json, subprocess, sys, wave
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace/src")
from instruments import build_all_instruments
from theory import Pattern
from drums_bass import write_drums_and_bass
from melody_harmony import write_melody_and_harmony

SONG_NAME = "Razor Horizon"
BPM = 144
SPEED = 6
CHANNELS = 12
N_PATS = 16

def run_ft2_batch(ops, json_path="/workspace/scratch/build_ops.json"):
    with open(json_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(ops, f)
    res = subprocess.run(["ft2", "batch", json_path], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if res.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"ft2 batch failed ({res.returncode}): {res.stderr[:1000]} {res.stdout[:1000]}")
    # Check if any tool reported isError: true
    for line in res.stdout.splitlines():
        if '"isError": true' in line or '"isError":true' in line:
            raise RuntimeError(f"ft2 tool error: {line}")

def build_module_ops(insts, patterns, order_list, loop_start=0, active_channels=None):
    ops = [
        {"name": "module_new", "arguments": {"channels": CHANNELS, "name": SONG_NAME}},
        {"name": "song_set", "arguments": {
            "name": SONG_NAME, "bpm": BPM, "speed": SPEED,
            "length": len(order_list), "loop_start": loop_start, "channels": CHANNELS
        }},
    ]
    for ins in insts:
        pcm_b64 = base64.b64encode(ins["pcm"].tobytes()).decode("ascii")
        ops.append({"name": "instrument_set", "arguments": {"instrument": ins["id"], "name": ins["name"]}})
        ops.append({"name": "sample_create_from_pcm", "arguments": {
            "instrument": ins["id"], "sample": 0, "pcm": pcm_b64, "encoding": "int16", "name": ins["name"]
        }})
        ops.append({"name": "sample_set", "arguments": {
            "instrument": ins["id"], "sample": 0, "name": ins["name"],
            "volume": ins["volume"], "panning": ins["panning"],
            "finetune": ins["finetune"], "relative_note": ins["relative_note"],
            "loop_start": ins["loop_start"], "loop_length": ins["loop_length"],
            "flags": ins["flags"]
        }})

    for p in patterns:
        if active_channels is None:
            ops.extend(p.to_ft2_ops())
        else:
            p_sub = Pattern(p.pat_idx, p.rows, p.channels)
            for (r, ch), cell in p.cells.items():
                if ch in active_channels:
                    p_sub.cells[(r, ch)] = dict(cell)
            ops.extend(p_sub.to_ft2_ops())

    for pos, pat_idx in enumerate(order_list):
        ops.append({"name": "order_set", "arguments": {"position": pos, "pattern": pat_idx}})
    return ops

    with wave.open(str(path), "rb") as w:

"""Assemble tune.xm via FT2, render WAV + stem buses, and run full DSP/mix/loop verification."""

import base64, json, subprocess, sys, wave
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace/src")
from instruments import build_all_instruments
from theory import Pattern
from drums_bass import write_drums_and_bass
from melody_harmony import write_melody_and_harmony

SONG_NAME = "Razor Horizon"
BPM = 144
SPEED = 6
CHANNELS = 12
N_PATS = 16

def run_ft2_batch(ops, json_path="/workspace/scratch/build_ops.json"):
    with open(json_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(ops, f)
    res = subprocess.run(["ft2", "batch", json_path], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if res.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"ft2 batch failed ({res.returncode}): {res.stderr[:1000]} {res.stdout[:1000]}")
    # Check if any tool reported isError: true
    for line in res.stdout.splitlines():
        if '"isError": true' in line or '"isError":true' in line:
            raise RuntimeError(f"ft2 tool error: {line}")

def build_module_ops(insts, patterns, order_list, loop_start=0, active_channels=None):
    ops = [
        {"name": "module_new", "arguments": {"channels": CHANNELS, "name": SONG_NAME}},
        {"name": "song_set", "arguments": {
            "name": SONG_NAME, "bpm": BPM, "speed": SPEED,
            "length": len(order_list), "loop_start": loop_start, "channels": CHANNELS
        }},
    ]
    for ins in insts:
        pcm_b64 = base64.b64encode(ins["pcm"].tobytes()).decode("ascii")
        ops.append({"name": "instrument_set", "arguments": {"instrument": ins["id"], "name": ins["name"]}})
        ops.append({"name": "sample_create_from_pcm", "arguments": {
            "instrument": ins["id"], "sample": 0, "pcm": pcm_b64, "encoding": "int16", "name": ins["name"]
        }})
        ops.append({"name": "sample_set", "arguments": {
            "instrument": ins["id"], "sample": 0, "name": ins["name"],
            "volume": ins["volume"], "panning": ins["panning"],
            "finetune": ins["finetune"], "relative_note": ins["relative_note"],
            "loop_start": ins["loop_start"], "loop_length": ins["loop_length"],
            "flags": ins["flags"]
        }})

    for p in patterns:
        if active_channels is None:
            ops.extend(p.to_ft2_ops())
        else:
            p_sub = Pattern(p.pat_idx, p.rows, p.channels)
            for (r, ch), cell in p.cells.items():
                if ch in active_channels:
                    p_sub.cells[(r, ch)] = dict(cell)
            ops.extend(p_sub.to_ft2_ops())

    for pos, pat_idx in enumerate(order_list):
        ops.append({"name": "order_set", "arguments": {"position": pos, "pattern": pat_idx}})
    return ops

def load_wav(path):
    with wave.open(str(path), "rb") as w:
        sr = w.getframerate()
        nch = w.getnchannels()
        raw = np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()), dtype=np.int16).reshape(-1, nch)
    return sr, raw

def dbfs(val):
    return 20.0 * np.log10(max(val, 1e-9) / 32768.0)

def analyze_master(sr, audio):
    fl = audio.astype(np.float64)
    peak = np.max(np.abs(fl))
    clips = int(np.sum(np.abs(audio) >= 32767))
    rms_all = np.sqrt(np.mean(fl ** 2))
    rms_l = np.sqrt(np.mean(fl[:, 0] ** 2))
    rms_r = np.sqrt(np.mean(fl[:, 1] ** 2))
    dc_l, dc_r = np.mean(fl[:, 0]), np.mean(fl[:, 1])
    corr = float(np.corrcoef(fl[:, 0], fl[:, 1])[0, 1])

    print("=== MASTER AUDIO QA ===")
    print(f"Duration       : {len(fl)/sr:.3f} s ({len(fl)} stereo frames @ {sr} Hz)")
    print(f"True Sample Pk : {int(peak)} / 32768 ({dbfs(peak):.2f} dBFS), Clipped samples = {clips}")
    print(f"Integrated RMS : {dbfs(rms_all):.2f} dBFS (Crest factor = {dbfs(peak) - dbfs(rms_all):.2f} dB)")
    print(f"L / R Balance  : L={dbfs(rms_l):.2f} dBFS, R={dbfs(rms_r):.2f} dBFS (diff = {dbfs(rms_l)-dbfs(rms_r):+.2f} dB)")
    print(f"Stereo Corr    : {corr:+.3f} (DC offset L={dc_l:+.2f}, R={dc_r:+.2f})")

    # 7-Band Spectral Balance via Welch-like windowed FFT chunks
    mono = 0.5 * (fl[:, 0] + fl[:, 1])
    win_n = 16384
    step = 8192
    acc = np.zeros(win_n // 2 + 1)
    win = np.hanning(win_n)
    cnt = 0
    for start in range(0, len(mono) - win_n, step):
        spec = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(mono[start:start + win_n] * win)) ** 2
        acc += spec
        cnt += 1
    acc /= max(cnt, 1)
    freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(win_n, 1.0 / sr)
    tot_e = np.sum(acc[(freqs >= 20) & (freqs <= 20000)]) + 1e-12
    bands = [
        ("Sub    20-60 Hz",   20, 60),
        ("Bass   60-160 Hz",  60, 160),
        ("LowMid 160-400 Hz", 160, 400),
        ("Mid    400-1.2k",   400, 1200),
        ("UpMid  1.2-3.5k",   1200, 3500),
        ("Pres   3.5-8.0k",   3500, 8000),
        ("Air    8.0-20k",    8000, 20000),
    ]
    print("\n=== 7-BAND SPECTRAL ENERGY ===")
    for bname, flo, fhi in bands:
        be = np.sum(acc[(freqs >= flo) & (freqs < fhi)])
        pct = 100.0 * be / tot_e
        rel_db = 10.0 * np.log10(be / tot_e + 1e-12)
        print(f"  {bname:18s}: {pct:5.1f}% ({rel_db:+6.2f} dB rel)")

    # Per-Pattern Dynamic Arc
    pat_sec = 64 * 6 * (2.5 / BPM)
    pat_frames = int(round(pat_sec * sr))
    sec_names = [
        "I.Ignition1", "I.Ignition2", "II.ThemeA1", "II.ThemeA2",
        "II.ThemeA3",  "II.Circle5",  "III.Chor1",  "III.Chor2",
        "III.Chor3",   "III.StopBrk", "IV.Breakdn", "IV.SoloBld",
        "V.Climax1",   "V.Climax2",   "V.Climax3",  "V.Turnarnd"
    ]
    print("\n=== PER-PATTERN DYNAMIC & STEREO ARC ===")
    for p in range(N_PATS):
        s0 = p * pat_frames
        s1 = min(len(fl), (p + 1) * pat_frames)
        seg = fl[s0:s1]
        p_rms = np.sqrt(np.mean(seg ** 2))
        p_pk  = np.max(np.abs(seg))
        p_cor = float(np.corrcoef(seg[:, 0], seg[:, 1])[0, 1])
        print(f"  Pat {p:2d} ({sec_names[p]:11s}): RMS={dbfs(p_rms):6.2f} dBFS | Peak={dbfs(p_pk):6.2f} dBFS | Corr={p_cor:+.2f}")

def main():
    Path("/workspace/submission").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    Path("/workspace/scratch").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    insts = build_all_instruments()
    patterns = [Pattern(i, rows=64, channels=CHANNELS) for i in range(N_PATS)]
    write_drums_and_bass(patterns)
    write_melody_and_harmony(patterns)

    # 1. Build & save official submission module + WAV preview
    ops_main = build_module_ops(insts, patterns, list(range(N_PATS)), loop_start=0)
    ops_main.append({"name": "module_save", "arguments": {"path": "/workspace/submission/tune.xm", "format": "xm"}})
    ops_main.append({"name": "module_render", "arguments": {"path": "/workspace/submission/preview.wav", "rate": 44100, "bits": 16}})
    run_ft2_batch(ops_main, "/workspace/scratch/ops_main.json")

    sr, master_wav = load_wav("/workspace/submission/preview.wav")
    analyze_master(sr, master_wav)

    # 2. Build 2x-loop-unrolled module to inspect the EXACT loop wrap seam (Pat 15 -> Pat 0)!
    ops_loop = build_module_ops(insts, patterns, list(range(N_PATS)) + [0, 1], loop_start=0)
    ops_loop.append({"name": "module_render", "arguments": {"path": "/workspace/scratch/loop_verify.wav", "rate": 44100, "bits": 16}})
    run_ft2_batch(ops_loop, "/workspace/scratch/ops_loop.json")
    _, loop_wav = load_wav("/workspace/scratch/loop_verify.wav")

    seam_idx = len(master_wav)  # exact sample where Pat 15 Row 63 wraps to Pat 0 Row 0!
    seam_win = loop_wav[seam_idx - 8 : seam_idx + 8].astype(np.float64)
    max_step_around = np.max(np.abs(np.diff(loop_wav[seam_idx - 2000 : seam_idx + 2000].astype(np.float64), axis=0)))
    exact_seam_step = np.max(np.abs(loop_wav[seam_idx].astype(np.float64) - loop_wav[seam_idx - 1].astype(np.float64)))
    # Compare Pat 0 on Pass 1 vs Pat 0 on Pass 2 (after 0.3s so crash/kick downbeat settles)
    p0_frames = seam_idx // N_PATS
    pass1_tail = master_wav[int(0.4 * sr) : p0_frames].astype(np.float64)
    pass2_tail = loop_wav[seam_idx + int(0.4 * sr) : seam_idx + p0_frames].astype(np.float64)
    diff_rms = np.sqrt(np.mean((pass1_tail - pass2_tail) ** 2))

    print("\n=== LOOP SEAM CONTINUITY AUDIT (Pat 15 Row 63 -> Pat 0 Row 0) ===")
    print(f"Seam sample index        : {seam_idx} ({seam_idx/sr:.4f} s)")
    print(f"Sample step AT seam      : {exact_seam_step:.1f} (vs local transient max step {max_step_around:.1f})")
    print(f"Pass1 vs Pass2 Pat0 diff : {dbfs(diff_rms):.2f} dBFS (checks hanging note bleed)")

    # 3. Render Stem Buses to check mix balance!
    stems = [
        ("Drums (Ch 0-2)",     {0, 1, 2}),
        ("Bass  (Ch 3-4)",     {3, 4}),
        ("Leads (Ch 5-6)",     {5, 6}),
        ("Bell  (Ch 7)",       {7}),
        ("Arps  (Ch 8-9)",     {8, 9}),
        ("Stab+Pad (Ch 10-11)",{10, 11}),
    ]
    print("\n=== STEM BUS MIX BALANCE ===")
    for sname, ch_set in stems:
        ops_s = build_module_ops(insts, patterns, list(range(N_PATS)), loop_start=0, active_channels=ch_set)
        wpath = f"/workspace/scratch/stem_{min(ch_set)}.wav"
        ops_s.append({"name": "module_render", "arguments": {"path": wpath, "rate": 44100, "bits": 16}})
        run_ft2_batch(ops_s, "/workspace/scratch/ops_stem.json")
        _, sw = load_wav(wpath)
        sf = sw.astype(np.float64)
        # Measure both overall RMS and active-frames RMS (where stem > -55 dBFS)
        frame_env = np.sqrt(np.mean(sf ** 2, axis=1))
        active = sf[frame_env > 60.0]
        act_rms = np.sqrt(np.mean(active ** 2)) if len(active) > 0 else 0.0
        pk = np.max(np.abs(sf))
        print(f"  {sname:20s}: Active RMS={dbfs(act_rms):6.2f} dBFS | Overall RMS={dbfs(np.sqrt(np.mean(sf**2))):6.2f} dBFS | Peak={dbfs(pk):6.2f} dBFS")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

{"command": "cat << 'EOF' > /workspace/src/instruments.py
import numpy as np

SR_STD  = 33452.0   # C-4 playback rate at relative_note = 24 (N=128 samples/cycle -> 261.34375 Hz)
SR_DRUM = 44653.0   # C-4 playback rate at relative_note = 29 (~44.65 kHz -> full 20 kHz drum/cymbal air!)
SR_HI   = 66904.0   # C-4 playback rate at relative_note = 36 (N=256 samples/cycle -> 261.34375 Hz)

def to_int16(x, peak=24000, fade_in=12, fade_out=0, remove_dc=True):
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64).copy()
    if remove_dc:
        x -= np.mean(x)
    if fade_in > 0 and len(x) > fade_in:
        ramp = 0.5 * (1.0 - np.cos(np.pi * np.arange(fade_in) / fade_in))
        x[:fade_in] *= ramp
    if fade_out > 0 and len(x) > fade_out:
        ramp = 0.5 * (1.0 + np.cos(np.pi * np.arange(fade_out) / fade_out))
        x[-fade_out:] *= ramp
    mx = np.max(np.abs(x))
    if mx > 1e-9:
        x = x * (peak / mx)
    return np.clip(np.round(x), -32767, 32767).astype(np.int16)

def svf_filter(x, sr, fc_arr, q=1.2, mode='lp'):
    """Time-varying Cytomic-style 2-pole State Variable Filter."""
    y = np.zeros_like(x, dtype=np.float64)
    ic1eq = 0.0
    ic2eq = 0.0
    k = 1.0 / max(q, 0.5)
    for i in range(len(x)):
        fc = min(max(fc_arr[i], 20.0), 0.46 * sr)
        g = np.tan(np.pi * fc / sr)
        a1 = 1.0 / (1.0 + g * (g + k))
        a2 = g * a1
        a3 = g * a2
        v3 = x[i] - ic2eq
        v1 = a1 * ic1eq + a2 * v3
        v2 = ic2eq + a2 * ic1eq + a3 * v3
        ic1eq = 2.0 * v1 - ic1eq
        ic2eq = 2.0 * v2 - ic2eq
        if mode == 'lp':
            y[i] = v2
        elif mode == 'bp':
            y[i] = v1
        elif mode == 'hp':
            y[i] = x[i] - k * v1 - v2
    return y

def bandlimited_saw(phase, n_harm=22, rolloff=1.0):
    out = np.zeros_like(phase, dtype=np.float64)
    for k in range(1, n_harm + 1):
        w = np.cos(0.5 * np.pi * (k - 1) / n_harm) ** 0.55
        out += ((-1.0) ** (k + 1)) * (w / (k ** rolloff)) * np.sin(k * phase)
    return out

def bandlimited_pulse(phase, duty, n_harm=22, rolloff=1.0):
    s1 = bandlimited_saw(phase, n_harm=n_harm, rolloff=rolloff)
    s2 = bandlimited_saw(phase - 2.0 * np.pi * duty, n_harm=n_harm, rolloff=rolloff)
    return s1 - s2

def make_kick():
    """Inst 1: Punchy Pitch-Swept Electronic Keygen Kick (44.65 kHz native)."""
    sr = SR_DRUM
    dur = 0.20
    n = int(sr * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / sr
    f_inst = 51.0 + 76.0 * np.exp(-t / 0.035) + 240.0 * np.exp(-t / 0.0048)
    phase = 2.0 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f_inst) / sr
    body = np.sin(phase) + 0.26 * np.sin(2.0 * phase) * np.exp(-t / 0.032)
    body = np.tanh(1.6 * body)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(101)
    click = np.sin(2.0 * np.pi * 2200.0 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.0020) * 0.45
    click += svf_filter(rng.standard_normal(n), sr, np.full(n, 3800.0), q=1.4, mode='bp') * np.exp(-t / 0.0022) * 0.30
    env = np.exp(-t / 0.082) * (1.0 - np.exp(-t / 0.0005))
    tail = np.clip(1.0 - (t / dur) ** 4, 0.0, 1.0)
    sig = (body * env + click) * tail
    return {
        "id": 1, "name": "Kick_Punch", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=26500, fade_in=4, fade_out=96),
        "volume": 64, "panning": 128, "relative_note": 29, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def make_snare():
    """Inst 2: Crisp Hybrid Analog + Demoscene Chip Snare (44.65 kHz native)."""
    sr = SR_DRUM
    dur = 0.19
    n = int(sr * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / sr
    rng = np.random.default_rng(202)
    f1 = 162.0 + 100.0 * np.exp(-t / 0.011)
    f2 = 258.0 + 115.0 * np.exp(-t / 0.008)
    p1 = 2.0 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f1) / sr
    p2 = 2.0 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f2) / sr
    body = 0.68 * np.sin(p1) * np.exp(-t / 0.034) + 0.36 * np.sin(p2) * np.exp(-t / 0.022)
    raw_noise = rng.standard_normal(n)
    lfsr_like = np.repeat(rng.choice([-1.0, 1.0], size=n // 3 + 1), 3)[:n]
    noise_mix = 0.80 * raw_noise + 0.20 * lfsr_like
    wires_mid = svf_filter(noise_mix, sr, np.full(n, 3200.0), q=0.85, mode='bp')
    wires_hi  = svf_filter(noise_mix, sr, np.full(n, 6200.0), q=0.75, mode='hp')
    wires = (0.58 * wires_mid + 0.72 * wires_hi) * (0.40 * np.exp(-t / 0.018) + 0.60 * np.exp(-t / 0.058))
    sig = np.tanh(1.35 * (0.78 * body + 0.92 * wires))
    sig *= np.clip(1.0 - (t / dur) ** 3, 0.0, 1.0)
    return {
        "id": 2, "name": "Snare_Crisp", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=25500, fade_in=4, fade_out=96),
        "volume": 64, "panning": 138, "relative_note": 29, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def make_clap():
    """Inst 3: Punchy Layered Synthwave/Keygen Clap (44.65 kHz native)."""
    sr = SR_DRUM
    dur = 0.18
    n = int(sr * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / sr
    rng = np.random.default_rng(303)
    noise = rng.standard_normal(n)
    bp1 = svf_filter(noise, sr, np.full(n, 1650.0), q=1.5, mode='bp')
    bp2 = svf_filter(noise, sr, np.full(n, 4800.0), q=0.9, mode='hp')
    env = np.zeros(n)
    for d_ms, amp in [(0.0, 0.85), (0.0085, 0.92), (0.0175, 1.0)]:
        dt = np.maximum(t - d_ms, 0.0)
        mask = (t >= d_ms).astype(float)
        env += mask * amp * np.exp(-dt / 0.0055)
    dt_tail = np.maximum(t - 0.018, 0.0)
    env += (t >= 0.018).astype(float) * 0.54 * np.exp(-dt_tail / 0.050)
    sig = np.tanh(1.3 * (0.62 * bp1 + 0.58 * bp2) * env)
    sig *= np.clip(1.0 - (t / dur) ** 3, 0.0, 1.0)
    return {
        "id": 3, "name": "Clap_Layer", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=23500, fade_in=4, fade_out=96),
        "volume": 60, "panning": 102, "relative_note": 29, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def _metallic_hat_source(n, sr, seed):
    t = np.arange(n) / sr
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    ratios = [1.0, 1.447, 1.932, 2.518, 3.291, 4.137]
    f_base = 3350.0
    metal = np.zeros(n)
    for idx, r in enumerate(ratios):
        f = f_base * r
        if f < 0.45 * sr:
            metal += np.sign(np.sin(2.0 * np.pi * f * t + idx * 0.7))
    metal /= len(ratios)
    air = rng.standard_normal(n)
    src = 0.38 * metal + 0.62 * air
    return svf_filter(src, sr, np.full(n, 7600.0), q=0.85, mode='hp')

def make_hat_closed():
    """Inst 4: Tight Crisp Closed Hi-Hat (44.65 kHz full 8-20 kHz air!)."""
    sr = SR_DRUM
    dur = 0.052
    n = int(sr * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / sr
    src = _metallic_hat_source(n, sr, 404)
    env = np.exp(-t / 0.012) * (1.0 - np.exp(-t / 0.0004))
    sig = src * env * np.clip(1.0 - (t / dur) ** 2, 0.0, 1.0)
    return {
        "id": 4, "name": "Hat_Closed", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=22500, fade_in=3, fade_out=36),
        "volume": 60, "panning": 68, "relative_note": 29, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def make_hat_open():
    """Inst 5: Sizzling Open Off-Beat Hi-Hat (44.65 kHz full air!)."""
    sr = SR_DRUM
    dur = 0.20
    n = int(sr * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / sr
    src = _metallic_hat_source(n, sr, 505)
    env = (0.40 * np.exp(-t / 0.018) + 0.60 * np.exp(-t / 0.075)) * (1.0 - np.exp(-t / 0.0006))
    sig = src * env * np.clip(1.0 - (t / dur) ** 3, 0.0, 1.0)

    """Inst 6: Punchy Pitch-Swept Electronic Keygen Tom (rel=24 so notes F#4..F#3 map cleanly)."""
    sr = SR_STD
    dur = 0.185
    n = int(sr * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / sr
    rng = np.random.default_rng(606)
    f_inst = 130.67 + 150.0 * np.exp(-t / 0.034)
    phase = 2.0 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f_inst) / sr
    body = np.sin(phase) + 0.24 * np.sin(2.0 * phase) * np.exp(-t / 0.03)
    stick = svf_filter(rng.standard_normal(n), sr, np.full(n, 2400.0), q=1.4, mode='bp') * np.exp(-t / 0.0045) * 0.32
    sig = np.tanh(1.3 * (body * np.exp(-t / 0.064) + stick))
    sig *= np.clip(1.0 - (t / dur) ** 3, 0.0, 1.0)
    return {
        "id": 6, "name": "Tom_Electro", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=24500, fade_in=4, fade_out=80),

    }

def make_crash():
    """Inst 7: Shimmering Crystal Keygen Crash (44.65 kHz full 20 kHz sparkle!)."""
    sr = SR_DRUM
    dur = 0.90
    n = int(sr * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / sr
    src = _metallic_hat_source(n, sr, 707)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(708)
    shimmer = svf_filter(rng.standard_normal(n), sr, np.full(n, 5500.0), q=0.75, mode='hp')
    mix = 0.52 * src + 0.48 * shimmer
    env = (0.45 * np.exp(-t / 0.055) + 0.55 * np.exp(-t / 0.32)) * (1.0 - np.exp(-t / 0.0018))
    sig = mix * env * np.clip(1.0 - (t / dur) ** 2.5, 0.0, 1.0)
    return {
        "id": 7, "name": "Crash_Crystal", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=21000, fade_in=8, fade_out=300),
        "volume": 54, "panning": 188, "relative_note": 29, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def make_bass_pluck():
    """Inst 8: Driving Resonant Pluck-Saw Keygen Bass (N=256, rel=36).
    Tighter low-end & punchier midrange resonant bite so bass cuts cleanly without excessive boom!
    """
    N = 256
    sr = SR_HI
    f0 = sr / N
    total_cycles = 36
    n_tot = total_cycles * N
    idx = np.arange(n_tot)
    phase = 2.0 * np.pi * idx / N
    raw = (0.62 * bandlimited_saw(phase, n_harm=28, rolloff=0.95)
           + 0.35 * bandlimited_pulse(phase, 0.28, n_harm=24, rolloff=0.95)
           + 0.30 * np.sin(phase))
    cyc = (idx / N) - 4.0
    env_decay = np.exp(-np.maximum(cyc, 0.0) / 4.2)
    w_settle = np.clip(1.0 - np.maximum(cyc - 10.0, 0.0) / 6.0, 0.0, 1.0)
    env_mod = env_decay * (0.5 - 0.5 * np.cos(np.pi * w_settle))
    fc_arr = f0 * (5.2 + 14.5 * env_mod)
    fc_arr[:4 * N] = f0 * (5.2 + 14.5)
    filt = svf_filter(raw, sr, fc_arr, q=2.0, mode='lp')
    amp_env = 1.0 + 0.32 * env_mod
    sig = np.tanh(1.22 * filt * amp_env)
    out = sig[4 * N : 36 * N].copy()
    out -= np.mean(out[16 * N : 32 * N])
    return {
        "id": 8, "name": "Bass_PluckSaw", "pcm": to_int16(out, peak=21000, fade_in=16, fade_out=0, remove_dc=False),
        "volume": 58, "panning": 128, "relative_note": 36, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 4096, "loop_length": 4096, "flags": 17
    }

def make_bass_sub():
    """Inst 9: Controlled Velvet Sub-Bass Support (N=256, rel=36)."""
    N = 256
    K = 64
    attack_cyc = 8
    n_tot = (attack_cyc + K) * N
    idx = np.arange(n_tot)
    phase = 2.0 * np.pi * idx / N
    idx_loop = idx - attack_cyc * N
    ph_up = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_loop * (K + 1) / (K * N)
    ph_dn = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_loop * (K - 1) / (K * N)
    sub = 0.76 * np.sin(phase) + 0.18 * np.sin(2.0 * phase)
    reese = 0.14 * (np.sin(2.0 * ph_up) + np.sin(2.0 * ph_dn)) + 0.07 * (np.sin(3.0 * ph_up) + np.sin(3.0 * ph_dn))
    sig = np.tanh(1.12 * (sub + reese))
    sig -= np.mean(sig[attack_cyc * N:])
    return {
        "id": 9, "name": "Bass_SubWarm", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=18000, fade_in=48, fade_out=0, remove_dc=False),
        "volume": 52, "panning": 128, "relative_note": 36, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": attack_cyc * N, "loop_length": K * N, "flags": 17
    }

def make_lead_razorsaw():
    """Inst 10: Hero Keygen PWM + 3-Voice Unison Razorsaw Lead (pan=84 left-focus)."""
    N = 128
    K = 256
    atk_cyc = 32
    n_tot = (atk_cyc + K) * N
    idx = np.arange(n_tot)
    idx_l = idx - atk_cyc * N

    ph0  = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_l / N
    ph_u = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_l * (K + 1) / (K * N)
    ph_d = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_l * (K - 1) / (K * N)
    duty = 0.33 + 0.13 * np.cos(2.0 * np.pi * 2.0 * idx_l / (K * N))

    core_pwm = bandlimited_pulse(ph0, duty, n_harm=20, rolloff=0.92)
    saw_c    = bandlimited_saw(ph0, n_harm=20, rolloff=0.92)
    saw_u    = bandlimited_saw(ph_u, n_harm=18, rolloff=0.96)
    saw_d    = bandlimited_saw(ph_d, n_harm=18, rolloff=0.96)
    steady = 0.42 * core_pwm + 0.28 * saw_c + 0.22 * (saw_u + saw_d)

    bite_env = np.zeros(n_tot)
    atk_len = atk_cyc * N
    u = np.arange(atk_len) / atk_len
    bite_env[:atk_len] = np.exp(-u * 4.5) * (0.5 + 0.5 * np.cos(np.pi * u))
    atk_bright = bandlimited_pulse(ph0, 0.15, n_harm=22, rolloff=0.88) * bite_env * 0.45

    sig = np.tanh(1.16 * (steady * (1.0 + 0.20 * bite_env) + atk_bright))
    sig -= np.mean(sig[atk_len:])
    return {
        "id": 10, "name": "Lead_Razorsaw", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=21000, fade_in=20, fade_out=0, remove_dc=False),
        "volume": 60, "panning": 84, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": atk_len, "loop_length": K * N, "flags": 17
    }

def make_lead_twinpulse():
    """Inst 11: Sweet Hollow Square-Pulse Harmony & Stereo Echo Lead (pan=184 right-focus)."""
    N = 128
    K = 128
    atk_cyc = 16
    n_tot = (atk_cyc + K) * N
    idx = np.arange(n_tot)
    idx_l = idx - atk_cyc * N
    ph0  = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_l / N
    ph_u = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_l * (K + 1) / (K * N)
    duty = 0.42 + 0.06 * np.cos(2.0 * np.pi * idx_l / (K * N))
    steady = 0.62 * bandlimited_pulse(ph0, duty, n_harm=18, rolloff=0.95) + 0.26 * bandlimited_saw(ph_u, n_harm=16, rolloff=1.0)

    atk_len = atk_cyc * N
    u = np.arange(atk_len) / atk_len
    bite = np.zeros(n_tot)
    bite[:atk_len] = np.exp(-u * 4.0) * (0.5 + 0.5 * np.cos(np.pi * u))
    sig = steady * (1.0 + 0.18 * bite)
    sig -= np.mean(sig[atk_len:])
    return {
        "id": 11, "name": "Lead_TwinPulse", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=20500, fade_in=16, fade_out=0, remove_dc=False),
        "volume": 58, "panning": 184, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": atk_len, "loop_length": K * N, "flags": 17
    }

def make_bell_crystalfm():
    """Inst 12: Crystalline 2-Op FM + Hollow Chip Pluck/Bell (pan=202 wide right)."""
    N = 128
    atk_cyc = 192
    K = 64
    atk_len = atk_cyc * N
    n_tot = (atk_cyc + K) * N
    idx_l = np.arange(n_tot) - atk_len
    ph = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_l / N

    dec = np.zeros(n_tot)
    u = np.arange(atk_len) / atk_len
    dec[:atk_len] = (0.65 * np.exp(-u * 6.0) + 0.35 * np.exp(-u * 2.0)) * (0.5 + 0.5 * np.cos(np.pi * u))

    mod_idx2 = 0.32 + 1.85 * dec
    mod_idx3 = 0.08 + 0.68 * (dec ** 1.5)
    mod = mod_idx2 * np.sin(2.0 * ph) + mod_idx3 * np.sin(3.0 * ph)
    fm_wave = np.sin(ph + mod)
    hollow = bandlimited_pulse(ph, 0.45, n_harm=14, rolloff=0.92) * 0.28

    amp = 0.25 + 0.75 * dec
    sig = (0.76 * fm_wave + 0.24 * hollow) * amp
    sig -= np.mean(sig[atk_len:])
    return {
        "id": 12, "name": "Bell_CrystalFM", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=24500, fade_in=12, fade_out=0, remove_dc=False),
        "volume": 62, "panning": 202, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": atk_len, "loop_length": K * N, "flags": 17
    }

def make_arp_pulse25():
    """Inst 13: Sparkling 25% Duty SID/Keygen Chip Arp Wave (pan=16 wide Left!)."""
    N = 128
    atk_cyc = 24
    K = 32
    atk_len = atk_cyc * N
    n_tot = (atk_cyc + K) * N
    idx_l = np.arange(n_tot) - atk_len
    ph = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_l / N
    wave = bandlimited_pulse(ph, 0.25, n_harm=20, rolloff=0.88)

    dec = np.zeros(n_tot)
    u = np.arange(atk_len) / atk_len
    dec[:atk_len] = np.exp(-u * 3.5) * (0.5 + 0.5 * np.cos(np.pi * u))
    sig = wave * (0.68 + 0.32 * dec)
    sig -= np.mean(sig[atk_len:])
    return {
        "id": 13, "name": "Arp_Pulse25", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=23500, fade_in=10, fade_out=0, remove_dc=False),
        "volume": 62, "panning": 16, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": atk_len, "loop_length": K * N, "flags": 17
    }

def make_arp_hollow12():
    """Inst 14: Plucky 15% Pulse Harpsichord/Chip Counter-Arp (pan=240 wide Right!)."""
    N = 128
    atk_cyc = 64
    K = 32
    atk_len = atk_cyc * N
    n_tot = (atk_cyc + K) * N
    idx_l = np.arange(n_tot) - atk_len
    ph = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_l / N
    wave = 0.78 * bandlimited_pulse(ph, 0.15, n_harm=20, rolloff=0.88) + 0.22 * bandlimited_pulse(ph, 0.50, n_harm=14, rolloff=0.92)

    dec = np.zeros(n_tot)
    u = np.arange(atk_len) / atk_len
    dec[:atk_len] = np.exp(-u * 4.0) * (0.5 + 0.5 * np.cos(np.pi * u))
    sig = wave * (0.34 + 0.66 * dec)
    sig -= np.mean(sig[atk_len:])
    return {
        "id": 14, "name": "Arp_Hollow15", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=24000, fade_in=10, fade_out=0, remove_dc=False),
        "volume": 62, "panning": 240, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": atk_len, "loop_length": K * N, "flags": 17
    }

def make_stab_polybrass():
    """Inst 15: Filter-Swept Synthwave/Demoscene Brass-Saw Stab (pan=42 Left-Mid!)."""
    N = 128
    sr = SR_STD
    f0 = sr / N
    warmup = 4
    atk_cyc = 96
    K = 128
    tot_cyc = warmup + atk_cyc + K
    n_tot = tot_cyc * N
    idx = np.arange(n_tot)
    idx_l = idx - (warmup + atk_cyc) * N

    ph0  = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_l / N
    ph_u = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_l * (K + 1) / (K * N)
    ph_d = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_l * (K - 1) / (K * N)
    raw = 0.42 * bandlimited_saw(ph0, n_harm=20, rolloff=0.92) + 0.29 * (bandlimited_saw(ph_u, n_harm=18, rolloff=0.95) + bandlimited_saw(ph_d, n_harm=18, rolloff=0.95))

    cyc = np.maximum((idx / N) - warmup, 0.0)
    u = np.clip(cyc / atk_cyc, 0.0, 1.0)
    rise = 1.0 - np.exp(-cyc / 2.2)
    fall = np.exp(-cyc / 24.0) * (0.5 + 0.5 * np.cos(np.pi * u))
    env_f = rise * fall
    fc_arr = f0 * (4.5 + 12.5 * env_f)
    filt = svf_filter(raw, sr, fc_arr, q=1.4, mode='lp')

    amp = 0.34 + 0.66 * (rise * (0.65 * np.exp(-cyc / 28.0) + 0.35 * (0.5 + 0.5 * np.cos(np.pi * u))) * (0.5 + 0.5 * np.cos(np.pi * u)))
    out = np.tanh(1.15 * filt * amp)[warmup * N:].copy()
    atk_len = atk_cyc * N
    out -= np.mean(out[atk_len:])
    return {
        "id": 15, "name": "Stab_PolyBrass", "pcm": to_int16(out, peak=21500, fade_in=32, fade_out=0, remove_dc=False),
        "volume": 56, "panning": 42, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": atk_len, "loop_length": K * N, "flags": 17
    }

def make_pad_ensemble():
    """Inst 16: Lush 5-Voice Chorus String Ensemble Pad (pan=214 Right-Mid!)."""
    N = 128
    atk_cyc = 32
    K = 256
    atk_len = atk_cyc * N
    n_tot = (atk_cyc + K) * N
    idx_l = np.arange(n_tot) - atk_len

    voices = np.zeros(n_tot)
    weights = [0.16, 0.22, 0.28, 0.22, 0.16]
    offsets = [-2, -1, 0, 1, 2]
    for w, m in zip(weights, offsets):
        ph = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_l * (K + m) / (K * N) + (m * 0.9)
        voices += w * bandlimited_saw(ph, n_harm=12, rolloff=1.25)

    env = np.ones(n_tot)
    u = np.arange(atk_len) / atk_len
    env[:atk_len] = 0.5 * (1.0 - np.cos(np.pi * u))
    sig = voices * env
    sig -= np.mean(sig[atk_len:])
    return {
        "id": 16, "name": "Pad_Ensemble", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=19500, fade_in=64, fade_out=0, remove_dc=False),
        "volume": 50, "panning": 214, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": atk_len, "loop_length": K * N, "flags": 17
    }

def make_fx_riser():
    """Inst 17: Shimmering Upward Filter-Sweep Riser (1.667s @ 44.65 kHz!)."""
    sr = SR_DRUM
    dur = 1.665
    n = int(sr * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / sr
    u = t / dur
    rng = np.random.default_rng(1717)
    noise = rng.standard_normal(n)
    f_sweep = 261.34 * (2.0 ** (2.0 * u))
    ph = 2.0 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f_sweep) / sr
    chip = 0.35 * np.sign(np.sin(ph)) * np.sin(2.0 * np.pi * 14.0 * t)
    fc_arr = 400.0 * ((12000.0 / 400.0) ** (u ** 1.35))
    swept = svf_filter(noise + 0.35 * chip, sr, fc_arr, q=2.6, mode='bp')
    env = (u ** 1.5) * np.sin(0.5 * np.pi * np.minimum(u / 0.96, 1.0))
    sig = np.tanh(1.35 * swept * env)
    return {
        "id": 17, "name": "FX_Riser1Bar", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=20500, fade_in=128, fade_out=400),
        "volume": 54, "panning": 196, "relative_note": 29, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def build_all_instruments():

        make_tom(),
        make_crash(),
        make_bass_pluck(),
        make_bass_sub(),

        make_lead_twinpulse(),
        make_bell_crystalfm(),
        make_arp_pulse25(),
        make_arp_hollow12(),
        make_stab_polybrass(),
        make_pad_ensemble(),
        make_fx_riser(),
    ]

messages.reasoning_content:
**Aha! The FT2 Panning Revelation!**

Okay, so I was looking at these RMS values and correlation coefficients and something clicked. Why was a specific pan setting in FastTracker II (FT2) yielding the same correlation? Time to dig into the math behind FT2's panning law! It's that classic `sqrt` equal-power panning.

Basically, with FT2's `0-255` pan range, `128` is center, `0` is full left, and `255` is full right. When you work it out, it means that even if you're not fully panned to one side, you're *still* getting a significant amount of the signal in both channels, because the left and right signals sum to give an output that isn't really fully stereo.

This is a real insight! Without delving into the stereo correlation, you'd completely miss this subtle but profound aspect of FT2's sound. At a medium pan setting, you get a strong presence of both signals in both the left and right outputs, essentially making it almost mono!

So, how do we leverage this to create a stunning stereo stage? Let's design!

*   **Kick:** Dead center, solid mono punch.
*   **Bass:** Same, for a phase-locked foundation.
*   **Snare/Clap:** Subtle width by layering.
*   **Hats/Crash:** Spread across the stereo field.
*   **Toms:** Dynamic panning for fills! The volume column can make beautiful left-to-right cascades!
*   **Lead:** Focused left-of-center for a prominent lead.
*   **Twin Lead:** Wide right-of-center, perfect for harmonies.
*   **Bell:** Sparkling right stage, a countermelody to the lead.
*   **Arps:** Very wide, filling out the left and right.
*   **Stabs/Pad:** Mid-left/mid-right, providing stereo depth.
*   **Riser:** Dead center (or sweeping), for a smooth transition.

Okay, now it's time for some gain-staging and EQ!

Looking at the initial run, I noticed:

*   **Clipping:** We had some clipped samples. We need to aim for zero clipping, with peak levels around -1.0 dBFS, and integrated RMS around -11.0 dBFS.
*   **Stem Balance:** The bass was dominating the drums in terms of RMS. That's because the bass has long, sustained waves, while the kick drum is a short impulse. I'll need to tighten the bass waves, and give its filter more bite so it can cut through.
*   **High Frequencies:** The high frequencies were a bit lacking. This is because the drums, hats, and cymbals were sampled at a lower sample rate. To fix this, I have to *synthesize* them at a higher frequency and then render them at the output rate for that classic, crystal-clear sound!
*   **Arps and Leads:** The Arps were too quiet. I need to bring them up a bit, and trim the leads so everything sits better together in the mix.

Finally, a quick note about the pattern/loop duration. It all aligns perfectly, so that's awesome.

Let's upgrade the drum fills with stereo tom panning and risers with subtle stereo swirl and update all the instruments. First update `/workspace/src/instruments.py` for new SR values for the high frequency drums, wide panning and EQ settings, then update `/workspace/src/drums_bass.py`, and re-run!

**Aha! The FT2 Panning Revelation!**

Okay, so I was looking at these RMS values and correlation coefficients and something clicked. Why was a specific pan setting in FastTracker II (FT2) yielding the same correlation? Time to dig into the math behind FT2's panning law! It's that classic `sqrt` equal-power panning.

Basically, with FT2's `0-255` pan range, `128` is center, `0` is full left, and `255` is full right. When you work it out, it means that even if you're not fully panned to one side, you're *still* getting a significant amount of the signal in both channels, because the left and right signals sum to give an output that isn't really fully stereo.

This is a real insight! Without delving into the stereo correlation, you'd completely miss this subtle but profound aspect of FT2's sound. At a medium pan setting, you get a strong presence of both signals in both the left and right outputs, essentially making it almost mono!

So, how do we leverage this to create a stunning stereo stage? Let's design!

*   **Kick:** Dead center, solid mono punch.
*   **Bass:** Same, for a phase-locked foundation.
*   **Snare/Clap:** Subtle width by layering.
*   **Hats/Crash:** Spread across the stereo field.
*   **Toms:** Dynamic panning for fills! The volume column can make beautiful left-to-right cascades!
*   **Lead:** Focused left-of-center for a prominent lead.
*   **Twin Lead:** Wide right-of-center, perfect for harmonies.
*   **Bell:** Sparkling right stage, a countermelody to the lead.
*   **Arps:** Very wide, filling out the left and right.
*   **Stabs/Pad:** Mid-left/mid-right, providing stereo depth.
*   **Riser:** Dead center (or sweeping), for a smooth transition.

Okay, now it's time for some gain-staging and EQ!

Looking at the initial run, I noticed:

*   **Clipping:** We had some clipped samples. We need to aim for zero clipping, with peak levels around -1.0 dBFS, and integrated RMS around -11.0 dBFS.
*   **Stem Balance:** The bass was dominating the drums in terms of RMS. That's because the bass has long, sustained waves, while the kick drum is a short impulse. I'll need to tighten the bass waves, and give its filter more bite so it can cut through.
*   **High Frequencies:** The high frequencies were a bit lacking. This is because the drums, hats, and cymbals were sampled at a lower sample rate. To fix this, I have to *synthesize* them at a higher frequency and then render them at the output rate for that classic, crystal-clear sound!
*   **Arps and Leads:** The Arps were too quiet. I need to bring them up a bit, and trim the leads so everything sits better together in the mix.

Finally, a quick note about the pattern/loop duration. It all aligns perfectly, so that's awesome.

Let's upgrade the drum fills with stereo tom panning and risers with subtle stereo swirl and update all the instruments. First update `/workspace/src/instruments.py` for new SR values for the high frequency drums, wide panning and EQ settings, then update `/workspace/src/drums_bass.py`, and re-run!

cat << 'EOF' > /workspace/src/instruments.py
import numpy as np

SR_STD  = 33452.0   # C-4 playback rate at relative_note = 24 (N=128 samples/cycle -> 261.34375 Hz)
SR_DRUM = 44653.0   # C-4 playback rate at relative_note = 29 (~44.65 kHz -> full 20 kHz drum/cymbal air!)
SR_HI   = 66904.0   # C-4 playback rate at relative_note = 36 (N=256 samples/cycle -> 261.34375 Hz)

def to_int16(x, peak=24000, fade_in=12, fade_out=0, remove_dc=True):
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64).copy()
    if remove_dc:
        x -= np.mean(x)
    if fade_in > 0 and len(x) > fade_in:
        ramp = 0.5 * (1.0 - np.cos(np.pi * np.arange(fade_in) / fade_in))
        x[:fade_in] *= ramp
    if fade_out > 0 and len(x) > fade_out:
        ramp = 0.5 * (1.0 + np.cos(np.pi * np.arange(fade_out) / fade_out))
        x[-fade_out:] *= ramp
    mx = np.max(np.abs(x))
    if mx > 1e-9:
        x = x * (peak / mx)
    return np.clip(np.round(x), -32767, 32767).astype(np.int16)

def svf_filter(x, sr, fc_arr, q=1.2, mode='lp'):
    """Time-varying Cytomic-style 2-pole State Variable Filter."""
    y = np.zeros_like(x, dtype=np.float64)
    ic1eq = 0.0
    ic2eq = 0.0
    k = 1.0 / max(q, 0.5)
    for i in range(len(x)):
        fc = min(max(fc_arr[i], 20.0), 0.46 * sr)
        g = np.tan(np.pi * fc / sr)
        a1 = 1.0 / (1.0 + g * (g + k))
        a2 = g * a1
        a3 = g * a2
        v3 = x[i] - ic2eq
        v1 = a1 * ic1eq + a2 * v3
        v2 = ic2eq + a2 * ic1eq + a3 * v3
        ic1eq = 2.0 * v1 - ic1eq
        ic2eq = 2.0 * v2 - ic2eq
        if mode == 'lp':
            y[i] = v2
        elif mode == 'bp':
            y[i] = v1
        elif mode == 'hp':
            y[i] = x[i] - k * v1 - v2
    return y

def bandlimited_saw(phase, n_harm=22, rolloff=1.0):
    out = np.zeros_like(phase, dtype=np.float64)
    for k in range(1, n_harm + 1):
        w = np.cos(0.5 * np.pi * (k - 1) / n_harm) ** 0.55
        out += ((-1.0) ** (k + 1)) * (w / (k ** rolloff)) * np.sin(k * phase)
    return out

def bandlimited_pulse(phase, duty, n_harm=22, rolloff=1.0):
    s1 = bandlimited_saw(phase, n_harm=n_harm, rolloff=rolloff)
    s2 = bandlimited_saw(phase - 2.0 * np.pi * duty, n_harm=n_harm, rolloff=rolloff)
    return s1 - s2

def make_kick():
    """Inst 1: Punchy Pitch-Swept Electronic Keygen Kick (44.65 kHz native)."""
    sr = SR_DRUM
    dur = 0.20
    n = int(sr * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / sr
    f_inst = 51.0 + 76.0 * np.exp(-t / 0.035) + 240.0 * np.exp(-t / 0.0048)
    phase = 2.0 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f_inst) / sr
    body = np.sin(phase) + 0.26 * np.sin(2.0 * phase) * np.exp(-t / 0.032)
    body = np.tanh(1.6 * body)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(101)
    click = np.sin(2.0 * np.pi * 2200.0 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.0020) * 0.45
    click += svf_filter(rng.standard_normal(n), sr, np.full(n, 3800.0), q=1.4, mode='bp') * np.exp(-t / 0.0022) * 0.30
    env = np.exp(-t / 0.082) * (1.0 - np.exp(-t / 0.0005))
    tail = np.clip(1.0 - (t / dur) ** 4, 0.0, 1.0)
    sig = (body * env + click) * tail
    return {
        "id": 1, "name": "Kick_Punch", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=26500, fade_in=4, fade_out=96),
        "volume": 64, "panning": 128, "relative_note": 29, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def make_snare():
    """Inst 2: Crisp Hybrid Analog + Demoscene Chip Snare (44.65 kHz native)."""
    sr = SR_DRUM
    dur = 0.19
    n = int(sr * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / sr
    rng = np.random.default_rng(202)
    f1 = 162.0 + 100.0 * np.exp(-t / 0.011)
    f2 = 258.0 + 115.0 * np.exp(-t / 0.008)
    p1 = 2.0 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f1) / sr
    p2 = 2.0 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f2) / sr
    body = 0.68 * np.sin(p1) * np.exp(-t / 0.034) + 0.36 * np.sin(p2) * np.exp(-t / 0.022)
    raw_noise = rng.standard_normal(n)
    lfsr_like = np.repeat(rng.choice([-1.0, 1.0], size=n // 3 + 1), 3)[:n]
    noise_mix = 0.80 * raw_noise + 0.20 * lfsr_like
    wires_mid = svf_filter(noise_mix, sr, np.full(n, 3200.0), q=0.85, mode='bp')
    wires_hi  = svf_filter(noise_mix, sr, np.full(n, 6200.0), q=0.75, mode='hp')
    wires = (0.58 * wires_mid + 0.72 * wires_hi) * (0.40 * np.exp(-t / 0.018) + 0.60 * np.exp(-t / 0.058))
    sig = np.tanh(1.35 * (0.78 * body + 0.92 * wires))
    sig *= np.clip(1.0 - (t / dur) ** 3, 0.0, 1.0)
    return {
        "id": 2, "name": "Snare_Crisp", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=25500, fade_in=4, fade_out=96),
        "volume": 64, "panning": 138, "relative_note": 29, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def make_clap():
    """Inst 3: Punchy Layered Synthwave/Keygen Clap (44.65 kHz native)."""
    sr = SR_DRUM
    dur = 0.18
    n = int(sr * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / sr
    rng = np.random.default_rng(303)
    noise = rng.standard_normal(n)
    bp1 = svf_filter(noise, sr, np.full(n, 1650.0), q=1.5, mode='bp')
    bp2 = svf_filter(noise, sr, np.full(n, 4800.0), q=0.9, mode='hp')
    env = np.zeros(n)
    for d_ms, amp in [(0.0, 0.85), (0.0085, 0.92), (0.0175, 1.0)]:
        dt = np.maximum(t - d_ms, 0.0)
        mask = (t >= d_ms).astype(float)
        env += mask * amp * np.exp(-dt / 0.0055)
    dt_tail = np.maximum(t - 0.018, 0.0)
    env += (t >= 0.018).astype(float) * 0.54 * np.exp(-dt_tail / 0.050)
    sig = np.tanh(1.3 * (0.62 * bp1 + 0.58 * bp2) * env)
    sig *= np.clip(1.0 - (t / dur) ** 3, 0.0, 1.0)
    return {
        "id": 3, "name": "Clap_Layer", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=23500, fade_in=4, fade_out=96),
        "volume": 60, "panning": 102, "relative_note": 29, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def _metallic_hat_source(n, sr, seed):
    t = np.arange(n) / sr
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    ratios = [1.0, 1.447, 1.932, 2.518, 3.291, 4.137]
    f_base = 3350.0
    metal = np.zeros(n)
    for idx, r in enumerate(ratios):
        f = f_base * r
        if f < 0.45 * sr:
            metal += np.sign(np.sin(2.0 * np.pi * f * t + idx * 0.7))
    metal /= len(ratios)
    air = rng.standard_normal(n)
    src = 0.38 * metal + 0.62 * air
    return svf_filter(src, sr, np.full(n, 7600.0), q=0.85, mode='hp')

def make_hat_closed():
    """Inst 4: Tight Crisp Closed Hi-Hat (44.65 kHz full 8-20 kHz air!)."""
    sr = SR_DRUM
    dur = 0.052
    n = int(sr * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / sr
    src = _metallic_hat_source(n, sr, 404)
    env = np.exp(-t / 0.012) * (1.0 - np.exp(-t / 0.0004))
    sig = src * env * np.clip(1.0 - (t / dur) ** 2, 0.0, 1.0)
    return {
        "id": 4, "name": "Hat_Closed", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=22500, fade_in=3, fade_out=36),
        "volume": 60, "panning": 68, "relative_note": 29, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def make_hat_open():
    """Inst 5: Sizzling Open Off-Beat Hi-Hat (44.65 kHz full air!)."""
    sr = SR_DRUM
    dur = 0.20
    n = int(sr * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / sr
    src = _metallic_hat_source(n, sr, 505)
    env = (0.40 * np.exp(-t / 0.018) + 0.60 * np.exp(-t / 0.075)) * (1.0 - np.exp(-t / 0.0006))
    sig = src * env * np.clip(1.0 - (t / dur) ** 3, 0.0, 1.0)
    return {
        "id": 5, "name": "Hat_Open", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=23000, fade_in=4, fade_out=110),
        "volume": 60, "panning": 58, "relative_note": 29, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def make_tom():
    """Inst 6: Punchy Pitch-Swept Electronic Keygen Tom (rel=24 so notes F#4..F#3 map cleanly)."""
    sr = SR_STD
    dur = 0.185
    n = int(sr * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / sr
    rng = np.random.default_rng(606)
    f_inst = 130.67 + 150.0 * np.exp(-t / 0.034)
    phase = 2.0 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f_inst) / sr
    body = np.sin(phase) + 0.24 * np.sin(2.0 * phase) * np.exp(-t / 0.03)
    stick = svf_filter(rng.standard_normal(n), sr, np.full(n, 2400.0), q=1.4, mode='bp') * np.exp(-t / 0.0045) * 0.32
    sig = np.tanh(1.3 * (body * np.exp(-t / 0.064) + stick))
    sig *= np.clip(1.0 - (t / dur) ** 3, 0.0, 1.0)
    return {
        "id": 6, "name": "Tom_Electro", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=24500, fade_in=4, fade_out=80),
        "volume": 60, "panning": 128, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def make_crash():
    """Inst 7: Shimmering Crystal Keygen Crash (44.65 kHz full 20 kHz sparkle!)."""
    sr = SR_DRUM
    dur = 0.90
    n = int(sr * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / sr
    src = _metallic_hat_source(n, sr, 707)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(708)
    shimmer = svf_filter(rng.standard_normal(n), sr, np.full(n, 5500.0), q=0.75, mode='hp')
    mix = 0.52 * src + 0.48 * shimmer
    env = (0.45 * np.exp(-t / 0.055) + 0.55 * np.exp(-t / 0.32)) * (1.0 - np.exp(-t / 0.0018))
    sig = mix * env * np.clip(1.0 - (t / dur) ** 2.5, 0.0, 1.0)
    return {
        "id": 7, "name": "Crash_Crystal", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=21000, fade_in=8, fade_out=300),
        "volume": 54, "panning": 188, "relative_note": 29, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def make_bass_pluck():
    """Inst 8: Driving Resonant Pluck-Saw Keygen Bass (N=256, rel=36).
    Tighter low-end & punchier midrange resonant bite so bass cuts cleanly without excessive boom!
    """
    N = 256
    sr = SR_HI
    f0 = sr / N
    total_cycles = 36
    n_tot = total_cycles * N
    idx = np.arange(n_tot)
    phase = 2.0 * np.pi * idx / N
    raw = (0.62 * bandlimited_saw(phase, n_harm=28, rolloff=0.95)
           + 0.35 * bandlimited_pulse(phase, 0.28, n_harm=24, rolloff=0.95)
           + 0.30 * np.sin(phase))
    cyc = (idx / N) - 4.0
    env_decay = np.exp(-np.maximum(cyc, 0.0) / 4.2)
    w_settle = np.clip(1.0 - np.maximum(cyc - 10.0, 0.0) / 6.0, 0.0, 1.0)
    env_mod = env_decay * (0.5 - 0.5 * np.cos(np.pi * w_settle))
    fc_arr = f0 * (5.2 + 14.5 * env_mod)
    fc_arr[:4 * N] = f0 * (5.2 + 14.5)
    filt = svf_filter(raw, sr, fc_arr, q=2.0, mode='lp')
    amp_env = 1.0 + 0.32 * env_mod
    sig = np.tanh(1.22 * filt * amp_env)
    out = sig[4 * N : 36 * N].copy()
    out -= np.mean(out[16 * N : 32 * N])
    return {
        "id": 8, "name": "Bass_PluckSaw", "pcm": to_int16(out, peak=21000, fade_in=16, fade_out=0, remove_dc=False),
        "volume": 58, "panning": 128, "relative_note": 36, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 4096, "loop_length": 4096, "flags": 17
    }

def make_bass_sub():
    """Inst 9: Controlled Velvet Sub-Bass Support (N=256, rel=36)."""
    N = 256
    K = 64
    attack_cyc = 8
    n_tot = (attack_cyc + K) * N
    idx = np.arange(n_tot)
    phase = 2.0 * np.pi * idx / N
    idx_loop = idx - attack_cyc * N
    ph_up = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_loop * (K + 1) / (K * N)
    ph_dn = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_loop * (K - 1) / (K * N)
    sub = 0.76 * np.sin(phase) + 0.18 * np.sin(2.0 * phase)
    reese = 0.14 * (np.sin(2.0 * ph_up) + np.sin(2.0 * ph_dn)) + 0.07 * (np.sin(3.0 * ph_up) + np.sin(3.0 * ph_dn))
    sig = np.tanh(1.12 * (sub + reese))
    sig -= np.mean(sig[attack_cyc * N:])
    return {
        "id": 9, "name": "Bass_SubWarm", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=18000, fade_in=48, fade_out=0, remove_dc=False),
        "volume": 52, "panning": 128, "relative_note": 36, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": attack_cyc * N, "loop_length": K * N, "flags": 17
    }

def make_lead_razorsaw():
    """Inst 10: Hero Keygen PWM + 3-Voice Unison Razorsaw Lead (pan=84 left-focus)."""
    N = 128
    K = 256
    atk_cyc = 32
    n_tot = (atk_cyc + K) * N
    idx = np.arange(n_tot)
    idx_l = idx - atk_cyc * N

    ph0  = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_l / N
    ph_u = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_l * (K + 1) / (K * N)
    ph_d = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_l * (K - 1) / (K * N)
    duty = 0.33 + 0.13 * np.cos(2.0 * np.pi * 2.0 * idx_l / (K * N))

    core_pwm = bandlimited_pulse(ph0, duty, n_harm=20, rolloff=0.92)
    saw_c    = bandlimited_saw(ph0, n_harm=20, rolloff=0.92)
    saw_u    = bandlimited_saw(ph_u, n_harm=18, rolloff=0.96)
    saw_d    = bandlimited_saw(ph_d, n_harm=18, rolloff=0.96)
    steady = 0.42 * core_pwm + 0.28 * saw_c + 0.22 * (saw_u + saw_d)

    bite_env = np.zeros(n_tot)
    atk_len = atk_cyc * N
    u = np.arange(atk_len) / atk_len
    bite_env[:atk_len] = np.exp(-u * 4.5) * (0.5 + 0.5 * np.cos(np.pi * u))
    atk_bright = bandlimited_pulse(ph0, 0.15, n_harm=22, rolloff=0.88) * bite_env * 0.45

    sig = np.tanh(1.16 * (steady * (1.0 + 0.20 * bite_env) + atk_bright))
    sig -= np.mean(sig[atk_len:])
    return {
        "id": 10, "name": "Lead_Razorsaw", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=21000, fade_in=20, fade_out=0, remove_dc=False),
        "volume": 60, "panning": 84, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": atk_len, "loop_length": K * N, "flags": 17
    }

def make_lead_twinpulse():
    """Inst 11: Sweet Hollow Square-Pulse Harmony & Stereo Echo Lead (pan=184 right-focus)."""
    N = 128
    K = 128
    atk_cyc = 16
    n_tot = (atk_cyc + K) * N
    idx = np.arange(n_tot)
    idx_l = idx - atk_cyc * N
    ph0  = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_l / N
    ph_u = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_l * (K + 1) / (K * N)
    duty = 0.42 + 0.06 * np.cos(2.0 * np.pi * idx_l / (K * N))
    steady = 0.62 * bandlimited_pulse(ph0, duty, n_harm=18, rolloff=0.95) + 0.26 * bandlimited_saw(ph_u, n_harm=16, rolloff=1.0)

    atk_len = atk_cyc * N
    u = np.arange(atk_len) / atk_len
    bite = np.zeros(n_tot)
    bite[:atk_len] = np.exp(-u * 4.0) * (0.5 + 0.5 * np.cos(np.pi * u))
    sig = steady * (1.0 + 0.18 * bite)
    sig -= np.mean(sig[atk_len:])
    return {
        "id": 11, "name": "Lead_TwinPulse", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=20500, fade_in=16, fade_out=0, remove_dc=False),
        "volume": 58, "panning": 184, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": atk_len, "loop_length": K * N, "flags": 17
    }

def make_bell_crystalfm():
    """Inst 12: Crystalline 2-Op FM + Hollow Chip Pluck/Bell (pan=202 wide right)."""
    N = 128
    atk_cyc = 192
    K = 64
    atk_len = atk_cyc * N
    n_tot = (atk_cyc + K) * N
    idx_l = np.arange(n_tot) - atk_len
    ph = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_l / N

    dec = np.zeros(n_tot)
    u = np.arange(atk_len) / atk_len
    dec[:atk_len] = (0.65 * np.exp(-u * 6.0) + 0.35 * np.exp(-u * 2.0)) * (0.5 + 0.5 * np.cos(np.pi * u))

    mod_idx2 = 0.32 + 1.85 * dec
    mod_idx3 = 0.08 + 0.68 * (dec ** 1.5)
    mod = mod_idx2 * np.sin(2.0 * ph) + mod_idx3 * np.sin(3.0 * ph)
    fm_wave = np.sin(ph + mod)
    hollow = bandlimited_pulse(ph, 0.45, n_harm=14, rolloff=0.92) * 0.28

    amp = 0.25 + 0.75 * dec
    sig = (0.76 * fm_wave + 0.24 * hollow) * amp
    sig -= np.mean(sig[atk_len:])
    return {
        "id": 12, "name": "Bell_CrystalFM", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=24500, fade_in=12, fade_out=0, remove_dc=False),
        "volume": 62, "panning": 202, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": atk_len, "loop_length": K * N, "flags": 17
    }

def make_arp_pulse25():
    """Inst 13: Sparkling 25% Duty SID/Keygen Chip Arp Wave (pan=16 wide Left!)."""
    N = 128
    atk_cyc = 24
    K = 32
    atk_len = atk_cyc * N
    n_tot = (atk_cyc + K) * N
    idx_l = np.arange(n_tot) - atk_len
    ph = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_l / N
    wave = bandlimited_pulse(ph, 0.25, n_harm=20, rolloff=0.88)

    dec = np.zeros(n_tot)
    u = np.arange(atk_len) / atk_len
    dec[:atk_len] = np.exp(-u * 3.5) * (0.5 + 0.5 * np.cos(np.pi * u))
    sig = wave * (0.68 + 0.32 * dec)
    sig -= np.mean(sig[atk_len:])
    return {
        "id": 13, "name": "Arp_Pulse25", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=23500, fade_in=10, fade_out=0, remove_dc=False),
        "volume": 62, "panning": 16, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": atk_len, "loop_length": K * N, "flags": 17
    }

def make_arp_hollow12():

def to_int16(x, peak=24000, fade_in=12, fade_out=0, remove_dc=True):
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64).copy()
    if remove_dc:
        x -= np.mean(x)
    if fade_in > 0 and len(x) > fade_in:
        ramp = 0.5 * (1.0 - np.cos(np.pi * np.arange(fade_in) / fade_in))
        x[:fade_in] *= ramp
    if fade_out > 0 and len(x) > fade_out:
        ramp = 0.5 * (1.0 + np.cos(np.pi * np.arange(fade_out) / fade_out))
        x[-fade_out:] *= ramp
    mx = np.max(np.abs(x))
    if mx > 1e-9:
        x = x * (peak / mx)
    return np.clip(np.round(x), -32767, 32767).astype(np.int16)

def svf_filter(x, sr, fc_arr, q=1.2, mode='lp'):
    """Time-varying Cytomic-style 2-pole State Variable Filter."""
    y = np.zeros_like(x, dtype=np.float64)
    ic1eq = 0.0
    ic2eq = 0.0
    k = 1.0 / max(q, 0.5)
    for i in range(len(x)):
        fc = min(max(fc_arr[i], 20.0), 0.46 * sr)
        g = np.tan(np.pi * fc / sr)
        a1 = 1.0 / (1.0 + g * (g + k))
        a2 = g * a1
        a3 = g * a2
        v3 = x[i] - ic2eq
        v1 = a1 * ic1eq + a2 * v3
        v2 = ic2eq + a2 * ic1eq + a3 * v3
        ic1eq = 2.0 * v1 - ic1eq
        ic2eq = 2.0 * v2 - ic2eq
        if mode == 'lp':
            y[i] = v2
        elif mode == 'bp':
            y[i] = v1
        elif mode == 'hp':
            y[i] = x[i] - k * v1 - v2
    return y

def bandlimited_saw(phase, n_harm=22, rolloff=1.0):
    out = np.zeros_like(phase, dtype=np.float64)
    for k in range(1, n_harm + 1):
        w = np.cos(0.5 * np.pi * (k - 1) / n_harm) ** 0.55
        out += ((-1.0) ** (k + 1)) * (w / (k ** rolloff)) * np.sin(k * phase)
    return out

    s1 = bandlimited_saw(phase, n_harm=n_harm, rolloff=rolloff)

def make_lead_twinpulse():
    """Inst 11: Sweet Hollow Square-Pulse Harmony & Stereo Echo Lead (pan=184 right-focus)."""
    N = 128
    K = 128
    atk_cyc = 16
    n_tot = (atk_cyc + K) * N
    idx = np.arange(n_tot)
    idx_l = idx - atk_cyc * N
    ph0  = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_l / N
    ph_u = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_l * (K + 1) / (K * N)
    duty = 0.42 + 0.06 * np.cos(2.0 * np.pi * idx_l / (K * N))
    steady = 0.62 * bandlimited_pulse(ph0, duty, n_harm=18, rolloff=0.95) + 0.26 * bandlimited_saw(ph_u, n_harm=16, rolloff=1.0)

    atk_len = atk_cyc * N
    u = np.arange(atk_len) / atk_len
    bite = np.zeros(n_tot)
    bite[:atk_len] = np.exp(-u * 4.0) * (0.5 + 0.5 * np.cos(np.pi * u))
    sig = steady * (1.0 + 0.18 * bite)
    sig -= np.mean(sig[atk_len:])
    return {
        "id": 11, "name": "Lead_TwinPulse", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=20500, fade_in=16, fade_out=0, remove_dc=False),
        "volume": 58, "panning": 184, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": atk_len, "loop_length": K * N, "flags": 17
    }

def make_bell_crystalfm():
    """Inst 12: Crystalline 2-Op FM + Hollow Chip Pluck/Bell (pan=202 wide right)."""
    N = 128
    atk_cyc = 192
    K = 64
    atk_len = atk_cyc * N
    n_tot = (atk_cyc + K) * N
    idx_l = np.arange(n_tot) - atk_len
    ph = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_l / N

    dec = np.zeros(n_tot)
    u = np.arange(atk_len) / atk_len
    dec[:atk_len] = (0.65 * np.exp(-u * 6.0) + 0.35 * np.exp(-u * 2.0)) * (0.5 + 0.5 * np.cos(np.pi * u))

    mod_idx2 = 0.32 + 1.85 * dec
    mod_idx3 = 0.08 + 0.68 * (dec ** 1.5)
    mod = mod_idx2 * np.sin(2.0 * ph) + mod_idx3 * np.sin(3.0 * ph)
    fm_wave = np.sin(ph + mod)
    hollow = bandlimited_pulse(ph, 0.45, n_harm=14, rolloff=0.92) * 0.28

    amp = 0.25 + 0.75 * dec
    sig = (0.76 * fm_wave + 0.24 * hollow) * amp
    sig -= np.mean(sig[atk_len:])
    return {
        "id": 12, "name": "Bell_CrystalFM", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=24500, fade_in=12, fade_out=0, remove_dc=False),
        "volume": 62, "panning": 202, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": atk_len, "loop_length": K * N, "flags": 17
    }

def make_arp_pulse25():
    """Inst 13: Sparkling 25% Duty SID/Keygen Chip Arp Wave (pan=16 wide Left!)."""
    N = 128
    atk_cyc = 24
    K = 32
    atk_len = atk_cyc * N
    n_tot = (atk_cyc + K) * N
    idx_l = np.arange(n_tot) - atk_len
    ph = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_l / N
    wave = bandlimited_pulse(ph, 0.25, n_harm=20, rolloff=0.88)

    dec = np.zeros(n_tot)
    u = np.arange(atk_len) / atk_len
    dec[:atk_len] = np.exp(-u * 3.5) * (0.5 + 0.5 * np.cos(np.pi * u))
    sig = wave * (0.68 + 0.32 * dec)
    sig -= np.mean(sig[atk_len:])
    return {
        "id": 13, "name": "Arp_Pulse25", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=23500, fade_in=10, fade_out=0, remove_dc=False),
        "volume": 62, "panning": 16, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": atk_len, "loop_length": K * N, "flags": 17
    }

def make_arp_hollow12():
    """Inst 14: Plucky 15% Pulse Harpsichord/Chip Counter-Arp (pan=240 wide Right!)."""
    N = 128
    atk_cyc = 64
    K = 32
    atk_len = atk_cyc * N
    n_tot = (atk_cyc + K) * N
    idx_l = np.arange(n_tot) - atk_len
    ph = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_l / N
    wave = 0.78 * bandlimited_pulse(ph, 0.15, n_harm=20, rolloff=0.88) + 0.22 * bandlimited_pulse(ph, 0.50, n_harm=14, rolloff=0.92)

    dec = np.zeros(n_tot)
    u = np.arange(atk_len) / atk_len
    dec[:atk_len] = np.exp(-u * 4.0) * (0.5 + 0.5 * np.cos(np.pi * u))
    sig = wave * (0.34 + 0.66 * dec)
    sig -= np.mean(sig[atk_len:])
    return {
        "id": 14, "name": "Arp_Hollow15", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=24000, fade_in=10, fade_out=0, remove_dc=False),
        "volume": 62, "panning": 240, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": atk_len, "loop_length": K * N, "flags": 17
    }

def make_stab_polybrass():
    """Inst 15: Filter-Swept Synthwave/Demoscene Brass-Saw Stab (pan=42 Left-Mid!)."""
    N = 128
    sr = SR_STD
    f0 = sr / N
    warmup = 4
    atk_cyc = 96
    K = 128
    tot_cyc = warmup + atk_cyc + K
    n_tot = tot_cyc * N
    idx = np.arange(n_tot)
    idx_l = idx - (warmup + atk_cyc) * N

    ph0  = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_l / N
    ph_u = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_l * (K + 1) / (K * N)
    ph_d = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_l * (K - 1) / (K * N)
    raw = 0.42 * bandlimited_saw(ph0, n_harm=20, rolloff=0.92) + 0.29 * (bandlimited_saw(ph_u, n_harm=18, rolloff=0.95) + bandlimited_saw(ph_d, n_harm=18, rolloff=0.95))

    cyc = np.maximum((idx / N) - warmup, 0.0)
    u = np.clip(cyc / atk_cyc, 0.0, 1.0)
    rise = 1.0 - np.exp(-cyc / 2.2)
    fall = np.exp(-cyc / 24.0) * (0.5 + 0.5 * np.cos(np.pi * u))
    env_f = rise * fall
    fc_arr = f0 * (4.5 + 12.5 * env_f)
    filt = svf_filter(raw, sr, fc_arr, q=1.4, mode='lp')

    amp = 0.34 + 0.66 * (rise * (0.65 * np.exp(-cyc / 28.0) + 0.35 * (0.5 + 0.5 * np.cos(np.pi * u))) * (0.5 + 0.5 * np.cos(np.pi * u)))
    out = np.tanh(1.15 * filt * amp)[warmup * N:].copy()
    atk_len = atk_cyc * N
    out -= np.mean(out[atk_len:])
    return {
        "id": 15, "name": "Stab_PolyBrass", "pcm": to_int16(out, peak=21500, fade_in=32, fade_out=0, remove_dc=False),
        "volume": 56, "panning": 42, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": atk_len, "loop_length": K * N, "flags": 17
    }

def make_pad_ensemble():
    """Inst 16: Lush 5-Voice Chorus String Ensemble Pad (pan=214 Right-Mid!)."""
    N = 128
    atk_cyc = 32
    K = 256
    atk_len = atk_cyc * N
    n_tot = (atk_cyc + K) * N
    idx_l = np.arange(n_tot) - atk_len

    voices = np.zeros(n_tot)
    weights = [0.16, 0.22, 0.28, 0.22, 0.16]
    offsets = [-2, -1, 0, 1, 2]
    for w, m in zip(weights, offsets):
        ph = 2.0 * np.pi * idx_l * (K + m) / (K * N) + (m * 0.9)
        voices += w * bandlimited_saw(ph, n_harm=12, rolloff=1.25)

    env = np.ones(n_tot)
    u = np.arange(atk_len) / atk_len
    env[:atk_len] = 0.5 * (1.0 - np.cos(np.pi * u))
    sig = voices * env
    sig -= np.mean(sig[atk_len:])
    return {
        "id": 16, "name": "Pad_Ensemble", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=19500, fade_in=64, fade_out=0, remove_dc=False),
        "volume": 50, "panning": 214, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": atk_len, "loop_length": K * N, "flags": 17
    }

def make_fx_riser():
    """Inst 17: Shimmering Upward Filter-Sweep Riser (1.667s @ 44.65 kHz!)."""
    sr = SR_DRUM
    dur = 1.665
    n = int(sr * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / sr
    u = t / dur
    rng = np.random.default_rng(1717)
    noise = rng.standard_normal(n)
    f_sweep = 261.34 * (2.0 ** (2.0 * u))
    ph = 2.0 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f_sweep) / sr
    chip = 0.35 * np.sign(np.sin(ph)) * np.sin(2.0 * np.pi * 14.0 * t)
    fc_arr = 400.0 * ((12000.0 / 400.0) ** (u ** 1.35))
    swept = svf_filter(noise + 0.35 * chip, sr, fc_arr, q=2.6, mode='bp')
    env = (u ** 1.5) * np.sin(0.5 * np.pi * np.minimum(u / 0.96, 1.0))
    sig = np.tanh(1.35 * swept * env)
    return {
        "id": 17, "name": "FX_Riser1Bar", "pcm": to_int16(sig, peak=20500, fade_in=128, fade_out=400),
        "volume": 54, "panning": 196, "relative_note": 29, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def build_all_instruments():
    return [
        make_kick(),
        make_snare(),
        make_clap(),
        make_hat_closed(),
        make_hat_open(),
        make_tom(),
        make_crash(),
        make_bass_pluck(),
        make_bass_sub(),
        make_lead_razorsaw(),
        make_lead_twinpulse(),
        make_bell_crystalfm(),
        make_arp_pulse25(),
        make_arp_hollow12(),
        make_stab_polybrass(),
        make_pad_ensemble(),
        make_fx_riser(),
    ]
EOF
python3 /workspace/src/build_and_analyze.py
"}
